info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Employee Data Update API
info.description: The Employee Data Update API enables businesses to efficiently modify existing employee records within the human resource management system. This API allows users to update various attributes of an employee's profile, such as personal details, job information, and contact data. Ideal for HR professionals and system integrators, it streamlines the process of maintaining accurate and up-to-date employee information. By utilizing this API, organizations can ensure that their HR data remains reliable and aligned with current employee statuses.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of an employee in the Human Resource Management system using their unique employee ID. Make sure to provide the necessary fields to be updated in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the employee data associated with the specified employee ID (EMP-900045) in the human resource management system. The submitted data should adhere to the defined schema which outlines the necessary fields and their respective types.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the employee data has been updated.
